annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Principal Fee: No annual fee, so long as you remain a SAFRA member. SAFRA membership fee applies.

our_takes.our-take: The SAFRA DBS Card gives cardholders 3% cashback on online and contactless payments, including SimplyGo rides, capped at SAFRA$50 per category. This makes it ideal for SAFRA members who frequently spend online or use contactless payment methods, helping to offset their SAFRA membership fees. A minimum spend of S$500/month is required to unlock these rates; otherwise, a meager 0.3% cashback applies. SAFRA$ expire after 12 months, limiting their long-term accumulation value. Ultimately, this card's value is tied to active SAFRA membership and consistent spending habits.
our_takes.good-for:
SAFRA members who frequently use Mastercard contactless for daily commutes and small purchases, maximizing cashback on these spends.
Online shoppers who want to earn cashback on their e-commerce transactions, provided they meet the minimum monthly spend requirement.
Individuals seeking access to SAFRA club facilities and exclusive member benefits while earning cashback on eligible retail transactions.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Cashback is capped at SAFRA$50 per category monthly; exceeding this limit means no further rebates.
A S$500 minimum monthly spend is needed; otherwise, you won't receive any cashback benefits.
High 27.8% annual interest rate; carrying balances will incur substantial charges if not paid off.
